transcript: Mard, 45 saal. Ek hafte se khansi. Pi lalab balgham ho raha. Luka buhar. Saans nahi. Fulta seene get dard hai. Trifor aadhi aadhi nahi. Augmentin 625 din mein do baar. 5 din khansi raat. Seraport do chamach din mein teen baar. Cigarette band karni hai. Cbc test check up. Lft karwa lein.
